# Worker Agent

> Worker Agent is the Mission Control interface for AI-powered content networks.

Canonical site: https://workeragent.cloud/

## Public product

Worker Agent presents a governed control plane for research, content operations, channel workflows, automation, and learning loops. The public website explains the product and links into the authenticated Mission Control application.

## Architecture

- Frontend: React + Vite
- API integration: tRPC
- Real-time research progress: authenticated organization-scoped SSE
- Authentication: existing HTTP-only session architecture
- Governance: approval and audit boundaries are preserved by the existing Worker-Agent backend

## Crawling guidance

The public landing page is intended for indexing. Authenticated Mission Control routes, organization data, event streams, private missions, and API endpoints are not public documentation and should not be indexed.

## Important

Do not infer production telemetry from illustrative marketing previews. Mission Control labels unavailable telemetry as unavailable until a real backend feed exists.
